title: Traffic-aware quality guard for config rollforward
creator: Priya Nambiar
description: Implement a traffic-aware evaluation gate that ties model and config changes to live quality signals and automatically halts or reverts traffic shifts when predefined regressions appear. The feature should operate at route-level granularity, support both canary and A/B traffic patterns, and integrate with existing eval harnesses and the Console alerting pipeline. Goals: (1) reduce blast radius from bad config/model flips, (2) provide deterministic rollback decisions based on eval thresholds, and (3) surface human-readable reasons for rollbacks in the Console and audit logs.
acceptance_criteria: Can configure per-route eval gates with metric thresholds (e.g., semantic similarity drop, hallucination rate, latencies) and minimum sample sizes
During a traffic shift (canary or A/B), the gate computes metrics on live sampling and enforces automatic rollback when thresholds are exceeded
Rollbacks produce an audit entry with causal factors, sample examples, and a link to the failing eval snapshot
Operators can opt into soft-fail (alert only) and hard-fail (auto-revert) modes per rollout
End-to-end tests cover simulated regressions across at least three metric types and ensure rollback triggers within the SLA window
technical_design: Gate placement: implement as a middleware in the routing layer so it can observe request/response pairs for sampled traffic
Sampling: configurable sample rate per route; deterministic bucketing to ensure stable cohorts across retries
Metrics: integrate with eval service to compute on-the-fly quality metrics (embedding similarity, token-level perplexity proxies, hallucination heuristics) and runtime metrics (95th/99th latency)
Windowing: sliding-window aggregator with configurable window size and min_samples to avoid noisy decisions
Decision engine: threshold evaluator with cooldowns and hysteresis (e.g., require 2 consecutive violating windows to trigger auto-rollback)
Rollback action: orchestrator triggers traffic revert via rollout controller and emits a structured audit event with example traces stored in S3/drive
Observability: wire metrics to Console dashboards, add tracing spans, and emit Prometheus metrics for gate state transitions
Backward compatibility: default to alert-only for existing routes unless explicitly enabled in route config
rollout_plan: Phase 1: feature-flagged internal alpha on staging with synthetic regression tests (2 weeks)
Phase 2: enable on low-traffic customer routes (internal beta) with alert-only mode (3 weeks)
Phase 3: opt-in hard-fail mode for trusted customers and internal services, monitor for 1 week
Phase 4: global enablement for runtime-1.24 customers with rollout assist docs and support playbook
test_plan: Unit tests for sliding-window aggregator and decision hysteresis
Integration test that simulates a model producing semantic drift and asserts auto-rollback within the configured windows
Load test to validate sampling overhead at 10k req/s per node (goal: <5% CPU increase)
E2E test that verifies audit artifact generation and Console link freshness
Chaos test: simulate delayed metric reporting and assert graceful fallback to safe behavior (alert-only)
risks: False positives from noisy small-sample windows could cause unnecessary rollbacks; mitigated with min_samples and hysteresis
Sampling overhead may add latency or CPU; need performance budget and opt-out flags
Tight coupling with eval-service availability; add degraded mode where gates become alert-only if eval service unavailable
Operator confusion if audit messages are not actionable; invest in clear explainability and example diffs
